description: Catalog of open-source chess engine projects. Fetch available releases from each upstream repository on demand.

metadata_notes.scope: One entry per source project; no engine versions, release assets, download endpoints or external ratings are stored.
metadata_notes.language: Primary implementation language where confirmed; null means it was not established during this catalog review.
metadata_notes.repository_archived: Archive status when checked on updated_at; the application can refresh repository metadata on demand.
metadata_notes.license: Names identify the license family or upstream declaration. Follow the linked upstream terms for exact versions, exceptions, dependencies and networks.
metadata_notes.availability: Inclusion identifies a source project. It does not promise prebuilt binaries, compatible releases or a completed installation test.
metadata_notes.repository_stats: Public GitHub numbers as of checked_at, refreshed by scripts/update.py: stars, forks, commits on the default branch (all time and in the 365 days before checked_at), contributors with GitHub accounts (null when GitHub would not count them), releases, and the days the repository was created and last pushed. Absent for repositories not on GitHub. Kept from the last check when the repository is unavailable.
metadata_notes.repository_available: Whether GitHub still had the repository when it was last checked. A renamed repository is followed to its new name; false means it was deleted or made private. Absent for repositories not on GitHub.
metadata_notes.ccrl: CCRL ratings of these engines are kept in ccrl.json, matched by name.
